summary: Iteration 3 E2E of HostNesia (Domain menu + Domain Detail 10 tabs, header saldo+topup, header profile dropdown, banner slider, Domain check w/ TLDs, Layanan submenu (Saya/Jasa/Order Baru), Hosting Service Detail action grid, Afiliasi, stat-domain nav, mobile). Backend pytest: 34 passed / 1 skipped (insufficient-balance path, non-deterministic — kept as before). Added 13 new pytest cases for iteration-3 endpoints (services category, /api/domains, /api/domains/{id}, /api/domains/check, /api/tlds, /api/affiliate, and 5 action variants on /api/services/{id}/action). Frontend: desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 both verified. All new UI testids resolve. Login -> dashboard (banner, header-saldo, header-topup-button, header-profile-trigger, 4 stat cards including stat-domain). Header top-up increased saldo 1.500.000 -> 1.750.000 via POST /api/wallet/topup. Profile dropdown shows Detail Akun Saya + Keluar/Log Out (profile-menu-logout logs out to /login). Domain menu shows 3 domain rows; domain search returns 8 results; popular TLDs .com/.id/.net/.my.id visible. Domain detail exposes all 10 tabs (overview, nameservers, registrar-lock, addons, kontak-domain, private-nameservers, dns-management, dnssec, domain-forwarding, kode-epp) with save/toggle toasts working, EPP code aB3x9-Kd7Le visible. Layanan submenu (via /layanan and /layanan/jasa) works: hosting rows (5 incl. previously test-created) and jasa rows (3) with 'Hubungi Tim'. Service detail action grid (cpanel/webmail/password/upgrade/unblock/cancel) all render and POST /api/services/{id}/action returns proper messages (verified change_password, upgrade, unblock_ip=1.2.3.4, cancel). Afiliasi shows Rp 1.250.000 balance + copy link + 4 stat cards + referrals. Dashboard stat-domain navigates to /domain. Mobile: bottom nav (nav-beranda/layanan/tagihan/profil), FAB, mobile-topup-button all present; Domain reachable via stat-domain card; Afiliasi/Domain/Jasa reachable via Profile page (profile-nav-*). No horizontal overflow at 390px.

issues: Clicking sidebar-layanan on desktop toggles the submenu open/closed. Since the submenu is 'open' by default (useState(true)), the FIRST click on Layanan actually COLLAPSES it, hiding sidebar-layanan-saya / sidebar-layanan-jasa / sidebar-order-baru. Users may expect a menu label click to expand-and-navigate rather than collapse. Consider (a) letting clicks on the label navigate to /layanan, and using a separate chevron for collapse, or (b) auto-opening when route is under /layanan. Non-blocking; the submenu items are still reachable via direct URLs and reappear after a second click.

action_items: Consider tweaking Sidebar 'Layanan' click UX so clicking the label doesn't collapse an already-open submenu (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: TopHeader profile dropdown lists 6 items above the separator and 5 items below including duplicate 'Profil Kamu' that also routes to /profil (same as Detail Akun Saya). Consider deduping to reduce menu length.
DomainDetailPage ToggleRow keeps only local state; toggles are not persisted through an API call (only a toast). Acceptable per mocked_apis_list, but flag for real-persistence backlog.
server.py get_domain returns ALL user dns_records (not filtered by domain), which is OK given mocked scope but semantically wrong if multi-domain DNS is ever real.

services.category field only exists on jasa services; hosting rows lack the field on older seeds. Seed does a follow-up update_many to backfill 'hosting', but that only runs when the hosting-services block also creates rows. If someone manually inserts hosting rows the backfill may be skipped. Consider moving the backfill outside the 'count==0' branch.

hash() used for domain-check availability is non-deterministic across Python processes (PYTHONHASHSEED). Not a bug per spec ('deterministic mock'), but strictly speaking not stable across restarts. Consider a stable hash (e.g., md5) if reproducibility matters.
